warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง; window heights printed as sill + window = head (0.85 + 1.20 = 2.05; 1.65 + 0.50 = 2.15) — all add up.
No scale is printed on this sheet.
